scope: 15 mechanisms from public secondary descriptions of the original Deck of Brilliance. Not the current 21-tool Essential Toolkit; not a complete deck.
attribution: Deck of Brilliance: Juggi Ramakrishnan and Todd McCracken (original deck). Application prompts, examples, tags, and checks below are original agency adaptations.

digitaling-2022.title: 52 creative tools, part one
digitaling-2022.caveat: English labels for entries from this source are working translations, not verified official titles. Author attribution in the article is not used as authority.

tools.name: Celebrate something larger
tools.core: Champion an ideal the audience shares.

application.prompt: Whose everyday contribution deserves recognition, and what can this brand actually do for them?
failure_modes: brand takes credit for others' work
application.original_example: A stationery company funds a public wall of local teachers' handwritten lessons; the teachers choose what remains on display.

tools.name: Dramatize the problem
tools.core: Heighten a real problem before revealing relief.

application.prompt: Which familiar irritation could become one unforgettable scene, with a product-specific resolution?
failure_modes: solution cannot resolve the depicted problem
application.original_example: For a cable organizer, a desk worker follows one tangled lead through a comically long office maze before returning to one labeled channel.

tools.name: Dramatize the solution
tools.source_heading: 04. 戏剧化地描述解决方法
tools.core: Build intrigue around the benefit's surprising result.

application.prompt: What unexpected behavior would make sense once viewers learn this product's benefit?
application.original_example: An office team silently performs an elaborate desk ballet; the reveal is a booking screen that has finally ended meeting-room clashes.

tools.name: Give the benefit a comic complication
tools.source_heading: 05. 用答案创造一个新的话题
tools.core: Let a benefit produce an amusing new difficulty.

application.prompt: What harmless new dilemma could appear if this benefit worked unusually well?
failure_modes: appears to reveal a genuine defect
application.original_example: A modular shelf owner keeps rearranging their room because every new configuration gives them another idea.

tools.name: Make the problem a metaphor
tools.core: Explain a difficult problem through a familiar parallel.

application.prompt: What everyday physical situation has the same structure as the audience's problem?
application.original_example: A team juggling incompatible file versions appears as a relay team running with five different batons.

tools.name: Reveal the making
tools.core: Expose the work behind the product.

application.prompt: Which hidden decision or repeated act of care would change how someone values this product?
application.original_example: A ceramic studio shows the same handle being tested by three makers, each explaining one adjustment a customer will feel.

tools.name: Name a recognizable behavior
tools.core: Naming changes how people perceive a behavior.

application.prompt: What recurring audience behavior lacks a useful, memorable name?
application.original_example: A reading app invites people to share their 'between-stop chapters': the pages read in otherwise unused travel minutes.

tools.name: Choose a revealing comparison
tools.core: A meaningful reference point makes value legible.

application.prompt: Which two situations make the benefit immediately understandable when placed together?
application.original_example: An inventory tool contrasts two versions of the same shop opening: one searching for stock, the other serving the first customer.

tools.name: Set a meaningful challenge
tools.core: Make the pursuit of a difficult goal a story.

application.prompt: What observable challenge could put our promise under useful pressure?
application.original_example: A repair brand documents its attempt to restore one neighborhood's unused bicycles over a weekend, publishing the completed and unfinished count.

tools.name: Bring consequence into view
tools.core: Bring distant actions and outcomes together.

application.prompt: Which delayed consequence can we show alongside the action without overstating causality?
application.original_example: A refill shop pairs each verified refill with the corresponding empty-container outline on an in-store display.

tools.name: Change the familiar viewpoint
tools.core: A changed perspective renews an ordinary subject.

application.prompt: What overlooked product truth becomes visible from another scale, speed, or point of view?
application.original_example: A textile brand films a seam as if it were an architectural structure, then pulls back to the everyday jacket.

application.prompt: If this invisible problem or useful function were a character, what would it want and do?
application.original_example: A duplicate spreadsheet row becomes an overenthusiastic colleague who repeats every announcement until a cleanup tool politely escorts it out.

tools.name: Build a public spectacle
tools.core: Create an event people want to witness and share.

application.prompt: What visible event would express the promise in a single shareable moment?
application.original_example: A lighting brand transforms a community court into a pattern of playing fields as local teams take turns switching on sections.

tools.name: Make the experience personal
tools.core: Adapt an experience to the individual.

application.prompt: Which preference can a person voluntarily contribute to make the result meaningfully theirs?
application.original_example: A tea shop builds a tasting route from visitors' chosen flavor notes and available time, with no account required.

tools.name: Offer a virtual experience
tools.source_heading: Replace a real experience with a virtual one
tools.core: Use digital experiences to widen access.

application.prompt: What valuable part of this experience is inaccessible, and what can a digital version genuinely convey?
failure_modes: simulation mistaken for the actual product
application.original_example: A music venue lets visitors explore seat-level sightlines through an interactive tour, with clear notes that audio is illustrative.
